uniques.name: Widow of the Stair
uniques.description: She waited on the sixth landing for eleven years. The garrison stopped using that stair.
uniques.ruleText: Backstabs restore 15 stamina.

uniques.name: The Gatewarden's Answer
uniques.description: Every petitioner got the same reply, and it was never spoken aloud.
uniques.ruleText: Parrying restores 30 stamina.

uniques.name: Last Muster
uniques.description: Forty-one names were called that morning. The blade belonged to the one who answered last.
uniques.ruleText: Each kill raises damage 4%, up to 6 stacks. Resets when you are hit.

uniques.name: Courtyard Vigil
uniques.description: Propped upright against the well, still angled toward the gate it was set to watch.
uniques.ruleText: Blocking restores 12 stamina.

uniques.name: The Heirless Crown
uniques.description: Cast for a succession that did not occur. The inner band was never sized down.
uniques.ruleText: Clearing a room yields 40 gold.

uniques.name: Stonewife's Band
uniques.description: Given at a wedding held during the siege. Both parties kept their promise, briefly.
uniques.ruleText: At low health, restores 60 health. Once every 90 seconds.

uniques.name: Debtor's Pendant
uniques.description: Pawned four times, redeemed three. The fourth ledger entry has no closing mark.
uniques.ruleText: Each kill yields 5 gold.

uniques.name: Sallyport Greaves
uniques.description: Made for men who had to be outside the wall and back before the horn finished.
uniques.ruleText: Dodging restores 8 stamina.

uniques.name: The Quartermaster's Tally
uniques.description: He counted every hammer out and every hammer back. This one he counted twice, then stopped counting.
uniques.ruleText: Hits have a 10% chance to stun.

uniques.name: Ledger of Debts
uniques.description: A page folded into a locket. The sums are still owed to somebody.
uniques.ruleText: Each kill yields 12 gold.

uniques.name: Sealed Requisition
uniques.description: Requested, approved, never issued. It waited in the vault for the war to come back.
uniques.ruleText: Each block raises defense by 3, up to 8 stacks. Resets on entering a floor.

uniques.name: Foundry Gauntlets
uniques.description: The palms are scorched through. The wearer kept working anyway.
uniques.ruleText: Critical hits restore 10 stamina.

uniques.name: Inventory of the Dead
uniques.description: Plate reclaimed from the fallen, restamped, reissued. The old marks show through the new.
uniques.ruleText: Taking a hit restores 8 mana.

uniques.name: The Ironmonger's Promise
uniques.description: He swore it would outlast the man who bought it. It has outlasted several.
uniques.ruleText: Hits heal you for 4% of the damage dealt.

uniques.name: Vaultkeeper's Helm
uniques.description: The eye slits were narrowed with a file, by hand, from the inside.
uniques.ruleText: Clearing a room restores 25 health.

uniques.name: Mire-Tongue
uniques.description: The edge was never sharpened. It did not need to be.
uniques.ruleText: Hits have a 35% chance to poison.

uniques.name: Drowned Procession
uniques.description: They walked into the fen in single file, carrying one of these each. Nobody counted them out.
uniques.ruleText: Killing a poisoned enemy spreads poison to nearby enemies.

uniques.name: Bog-Oath
uniques.description: Bound with reed cord swollen tight. Cutting it would take longer than the fight.
uniques.ruleText: Blocking poisons the attacker.

uniques.name: Fen Widow's Veil
uniques.description: Mourning cloth, waxed against the damp. It kept the flies off for a long while.
uniques.ruleText: Applying a status restores 6 health.

uniques.name: Leechbound Band
uniques.description: Worn until the finger beneath went grey, and then worn a while longer.
uniques.ruleText: Hits on poisoned enemies heal you for 6% of the damage dealt.

uniques.name: Stiltwalker's Greaves
uniques.description: The soles are worn flat on the outer edge only. He never once put his heel down.
uniques.ruleText: Dodging restores 6 stamina.

uniques.name: Rot and Remedy
uniques.description: The physician carried both in the same jar and stopped labelling which was which.
uniques.ruleText: At low health, clears all statuses from you.

uniques.name: The Long Winter
uniques.description: Drawn once at the start of a season that has not yet ended.
uniques.ruleText: Hits have a 20% chance to freeze.

uniques.name: Frostbitten Oath
uniques.description: Sworn with a bare hand on cold iron. The hand did not come away whole.
uniques.ruleText: Critical hits freeze the target.

uniques.name: Glacier Watch
uniques.description: Set into the drift as a windbreak. Two men sheltered behind it and only the shield was found.
uniques.ruleText: Blocking restores 6 health.

uniques.name: Rimeglass Pendant
uniques.description: Ice that will not thaw, in a setting that was made to hold something else.
uniques.ruleText: Killing a frozen enemy yields 20 gold.

uniques.name: Hearthless Cuirass
uniques.description: The fortress kept no fires for the last two winters. The plate learned to be enough.
uniques.ruleText: Each hit taken raises armor by 4, up to 6 stacks. Resets on room clear.

uniques.name: Snowblind
uniques.description: The archer shot at a shape in the white for an hour. There was no shape.
uniques.ruleText: Each critical hit raises damage 3%, up to 8 stacks. Resets when you are hit.

uniques.name: Thawing Band
uniques.description: Warm to the touch, always, for reasons the wearer preferred not to examine.
uniques.ruleText: Entering a floor restores 40 health.

uniques.name: The Unsaid Prayer
uniques.description: The last line was struck out of every copy in the library, in the same hand.
uniques.ruleText: Each kill restores 15 mana.

uniques.name: Reliquary of Ash
uniques.description: The hilt is a reliquary. What it holds was already burned when it was placed inside.
uniques.ruleText: Hits have a 25% chance to burn.

uniques.name: Confessor's Burden
uniques.description: He heard everything and carried it on his arm. It grew no lighter.
uniques.ruleText: Parrying restores 20 health.

uniques.name: Censer of Small Mercies
uniques.description: Swung down the aisle for the dying, never for the dead. The distinction mattered to someone.
uniques.ruleText: At low health, refunds one flask charge. Once every three minutes.

uniques.name: Choirless Helm
uniques.description: Lined to muffle sound. The wearer had already heard the choir once.
uniques.ruleText: Clearing a room restores 30 mana.

uniques.name: Lector's Gauntlets
uniques.description: Ink under the nail beds, permanent. He read aloud for thirty years and was not thanked.
uniques.ruleText: Critical hits restore 6 mana.

uniques.name: The Apostate
uniques.description: Consecrated, then used against the people who consecrated it. Nobody reconsecrated it.
uniques.ruleText: Backstabs heal you for 15% of the damage dealt.

uniques.name: Prism of No Colour
uniques.description: Light enters it. Something leaves. The two have never been shown to be the same light.
uniques.ruleText: Each critical hit raises damage 5%, up to 10 stacks. Resets when you are hit.

uniques.name: Facet and Fracture
uniques.description: It broke on the first strike and has broken on every strike since, without getting shorter.
uniques.ruleText: Critical hits cause bleeding.

uniques.name: The Singing Stone
uniques.description: It is audible only in the last room of a floor, and only to whoever is wearing it.
uniques.ruleText: Entering a floor restores 60 mana.

uniques.name: Lattice Ward
uniques.description: Grown across the doorway of a sealed gallery, then cut free and given a handle.
uniques.ruleText: Each block raises block reduction 2%, up to 6 stacks. Resets when you are hit.

uniques.name: Refraction Greaves
uniques.description: You arrive slightly before the sound of arriving. It is not restful.
uniques.ruleText: Each dodge raises evasion by 5, up to 5 stacks. Resets when you are hit.

uniques.name: Deep Cut
uniques.description: The shafts are knapped, not fletched. They go in straight and do not come out.
uniques.ruleText: Hits have a 20% chance to cause bleeding.

uniques.name: Cavernlight Helm
uniques.description: Set with a shard that lights nothing but shows the wearer where the walls are.
uniques.ruleText: Entering a floor yields 60 gold.

uniques.name: The Geode's Patience
uniques.description: It took nine thousand years to close. It objects to being opened in an afternoon.
uniques.ruleText: Each hit taken raises armor by 6, up to 8 stacks. Clearing a room resets the stacks and restores 35 health.

uniques.name: Crown of the Crystal Sovereign
uniques.description: Taken from a head that had grown into it. The removal was not clean and was not quick.
uniques.ruleText: Each kill raises damage 3%, up to 12 stacks. Clearing a room restores 40 mana.

uniques.name: Aumbral Verdict
uniques.description: The sentence was passed in a room with no windows and carried out immediately.
uniques.ruleText: Killing a bleeding enemy spreads bleed to nearby enemies. Backstabs restore 25 stamina.

uniques.name: The Quiet Hour
uniques.description: Between the last bell and the first, nothing was permitted to happen. Something did.
uniques.ruleText: At low health, clears all statuses from you and restores 80 health. Once every two minutes.
